name: Zuma Inspired Luxury
description: Smoked timber, mineral grain and a thin glint of aged bronze form a metropolitan Japanese interior with the intimacy of a private dining room. A pale upholstered island floats against a dark, deeply articulated wall; the composition is generous and sensual, with light caught on edges rather than flooding every surface. The signature is EMBER INTERVAL: two unequal mineral planes separated by a deliberately empty bronze-grey interval. It is an original domestic composition, never restaurant branding.

name: Modern Organic
description: A sculptural penthouse in warm chalk, mushroom, dark cocoa and soft flax. The owner's IMG_2589 montage contributes the tension between rough mineral surfaces, pillowy pale upholstery and a few dark reflective objects; the Etsy relief contributes the scale of shadow within a pale monochrome field. The original signature, TIDAL SHOULDER, is a broad asymmetric folded ridge with a low hollow, deliberately distinct from the reference artwork. Large quiet masses and real tactile shadows produce luxury within the existing apartment shell.

name: Westside Grand Continuum
description: The private continuation of the actual Westside Grand lobby: broad warm-grey timber planes, a dark mineral base, pale luminous frames and the measured rhythm of vertical divisions. The real lobby photographs provide a material grammar, while the apartment stays domestic and generous. COURTYARD MEASURE is the original signature: unequal rectangles and one circular void composed from the building's sheltered garden and lobby proportions, without copying the logo or turning the room into a reception desk.

name: Modern White Luxury
description: A luminous collector's interior where the original white walls are valuable negative space. Chalk, oyster, pearl and soft grey separate through weave, gloss and shadow rather than a colour filter. A few confident furniture forms and one large physical artwork carry the room. The signature, WHITE ECLIPSE, is a pair of overlapping pale planes with a displaced charcoal edge: precise, tactile and quietly dramatic. Money saved on extensive cladding supports upholstery, artwork and the quality of light.

name: Authentic Japanese Modern
description: A contemporary Japanese-informed home composed through intervals, asymmetry and carefully framed everyday use. Ash-grey wood, smoke-brown laminate, charcoal, off-white cloth and filtered light create a slightly darker atmosphere without red or orange timber. Empty surfaces are active parts of the design. The original signature, STILL INTERVAL, is a shallow pale folded plane beside a quiet dark void; its identity lies in proportion and material, not calligraphy, symbols or themed decoration.

name: Monza Magno | G 63 Residence
description: PRECISION SOFT translates the owner’s own G 63 into a warm home: softly squared ivory upholstery held inside satin graphite planes, fine silver-grey metal edges and restrained grey timber. The exterior photographs suggest a low-gloss mineral grey with changing warm and cool reflections; the cabin photographs show cream upholstery, narrow stitched channels, perforation, dark upper surfaces and silver details. These are visual observations, not verified paint or leather codes. The owner-supplied Monza Grey magno name remains an inspiration pending factory documentation. Form is substantial and protective, while the inhabited surfaces are soft and luminous.

name: Mercedes Design Collection Residence
description: CONTINUOUS LINE connects five distinct domestic moods through oyster textile, cool grey timber, graphite bases and a fine satin champagne-silver line. The living room is composed from G-Class rounded squares, the kitchen-dining room from an AMG GT long tapered sweep, the master from S-Class soft layered comfort, room 05.2 from SL open arcs and 05.3 from C-Class precise compact divisions. Each room changes the line’s rhythm rather than changing the palette. This is an independent owner-inspired interior, with no official manufacturer affiliation, logos or copied dashboard.
